knowledge.text: The rule: if it gives off its own light, it's the real sky (stars, nebulae, galaxies, the backdrop). Everything else is the AR overlay, projected from the orb (rings, shimmer, a pulse: Projection): moth, Cori, silk, HUD, frames, orb, fireworks.
knowledge.why: The whimsical fantasy art and the real star map pulled two ways. The overlay can be whimsical because it's drawn; the sky stays real.

knowledge.text: Premise: two park rangers map a new trail from very far away. The moth and the butterfly are their avatars on the feed.

Cast: the moth is the engineer (the site owner), callsign SURVEYOR; the butterfly is Cori (C.O-R.I: Cosmic Operations – Research and Information, steward of this sector), the local guide, in the game and across the site. Cori no longer rides beside the butterfly: it is the butterfly.
Words: constellation = a trail to resurvey; silk and the red thread = Cori's markers; fireworks = Cori celebrating a remapped trail; the mission = resurvey this sector.
The work is plain; Cori is the fun. The moth just remaps trails and the visitor just reads a portfolio; Cori adds the silk, the red thread, the fireworks and the press bursts over both.
knowledge.why: User: "i'm just remapping the trail, she makes it fun. the user is just reading a port site, cori makes it fun."

knowledge.text: Visuals tell the story, interactions tell the start. Lore only from Cori, a few words: the welcome and the mission on Play.
knowledge.why: Recruiters give it 1–2 minutes; a line from a character reads, a paragraph does not.

knowledge.text: Cori on the site: spawns after loading, flies around as in the game, lands on action items and points of interest; ≤ 2 sentences, speaks on landing or the side button, never covers content, calm = no flight, the line just appears.
The orb is the transmitter: the source of the overlay and the controller of the site and the game (Opening).
Site and game are separate places, themed and flowing the same. No work info behind the game: the game is dessert.

agent.brief: The story is told by the look, not by text: the real sky vs the drawn overlay, two ranger avatars, a feed. See Opening for the first-run screens and Avatars for the projection look.
rules: Anything that isn't a celestial object renders as overlay: signal lines, see-through, never photographic.
No lore paragraphs: Cori's welcome and the mission are the lore. The trail words show as labels in the game (TRAIL 001 · COMMITTED).
Cori lines ≤ 2 sentences, no "!", no emoji (Voice).
